text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...
Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, I was fast!
As expected of the speed-blessed Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It seems she wasn't just lightning-fast, but had reached supersonic speeds.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's proof of how much you've already grown!
In that case, let's move on to the next step!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Challenging the final leg of the Triple Crown races, the 'Kikuka Sho'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Or the gathering of Senior-class stars!
The pinnacle of medium-distance races, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)â

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho goes without saying,
but even the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is 2,000 meters.
It really is too long for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you're going to be running around the same time...
With that in mind—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wha-?! 
Why are you mad at me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, what do you mean by "treating" them?
I will not treat anyone. I won't buy popularity with money!
choice_data_list: ...It's too early to get carried away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!?
What do you mean by that?!
choice_data_list: Have you really mastered ultimate speed?
Have you really mastered ultimate speed?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about!
I produced proper results in this race too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'd say that's the ultimate proof of speed, though!
choice_data_list: That's something you can only say after winning a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race...!
Which means...
choice_data_list: The pinnacle of speed—the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Internationally renowned and, true to its name,
a race purely for sprinters.
This is the only race she should be running!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...! If I don't win that race,
I can't truly be called the fastest."
choice_data_list: Let's become the fastest class rep in both name and deed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The fastest... Class Rep...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I... will run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win the Sprinters Stakes
and become the fastest class rep!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "With that title in hand, let us add further glory to the Bakushin Road!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, Sakura Bakushin O...
is taking on the Sprinters Stakes!
